== Events ==
* [[The]]
* [[Toto has returned with Dorothy]]
* [[Dorothy tearfully says goodbye to her companions, clicks her heels, and is instantly whirled back to the Kansas prairie, though the Silver Shoes are lost during the flight]]
* [[The Scarecrow becomes ruler of the Emerald City, and the people take pride in being governed by a stuffed man]]
* [[On the fourth day Oz summons Dorothy and proposes crossing the desert by balloon since he cannot make a cyclone]]
* [[Oz lights a fire beneath the balloon to fill it with hot air and declares the Scarecrow will rule in his absence]]
* [[Left alone, Oz privately admits to himself that he is a humbug and worries he has no idea how to send Dorothy back to Kansas]]
* [[The Scarecrow goes to Oz to receive his promised brains]]
* [[Oz promises to give brains, courage, and a heart the next day and asks for time to find a way to send Dorothy back to Kansas]]
* [[Dorothy declares the Winkies free from slavery, ending years of cruel servitude under the Witch]]
* [[The Winkies give parting gifts, Dorothy takes the Golden Cap from the Witch's cupboard, and the group sets off for the Emerald City to claim Oz's promises]]
* [[The Witch tricks Dorothy into losing one Silver Shoe, but when Dorothy angrily throws water on her, the Witch melts away and dies, ending her tyranny]]
* [[The Tin Woodman, Scarecrow, and Lion praise Oz, while Dorothy privately forgives him for not keeping his promise]]
* [[A Stork agrees to rescue the Scarecrow, lifting him by the arms and carrying him back to the group]]
* [[The Scarecrow's pole sticks in the riverbed and he is left stranded in the middle of the river as the raft drifts away]]
* [[Having lost his ability to love the Munchkin girl he once wanted to marry, he now believes happiness requires a heart, while the Scarecrow still insists brains matter more]]
* [[Glinda agrees to help her but asks for the Golden Cap in exchange, which Dorothy willingly gives up]]
* [[Dorothy, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Lion get lost in the fields of buttercups and daisies while trying to walk back to the Emerald City]]
* [[Glinda agreed to receive Dorothy and her companions at once]]
* [[She frees the Scarecrow, and he joins her journey, hoping Oz will give him brains]]
* [[The beasts bow to the Lion as King, and he promises to return and rule once Dorothy is safely on her way to Kansas]]
